transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?

I'm here because I've been struggling with constant, uncontrollable worry about almost everything in my life for the past seven months. It has gotten to the point where it's just feeling completely overwhelming.
You mentioned the worry has been going on for about seven months. Has this worry occurred more days than not during that time?

Yes, definitely. It feels like it's there almost every single day, and it has definitely occurred more days than not over these past seven months. It has just become a constant, exhausting presence in my daily life.
Has this constant worry made it difficult to carry out your daily activities, like work, socializing, or taking care of yourself?

Yes, it really has. The worries constantly intrude into my mind, making it incredibly hard to focus on my tasks at work. It also spreads to other areas of my life, like constantly stressing over my family responsibilities, which makes managing my day-to-day routine feel completely overwhelming.
Do you also experience physical symptoms like restlessness, being easily fatigued, or muscle tension along with the worry?

Yes, absolutely. I constantly feel wound up like a spring and find it really hard to sit still. My entire body also feels incredibly stiff and tense, to the point where I just can't seem to relax at all.
